sources.evidence: Aruba Aloe's official site identifies Aruba Aloe Balm N.V. as the company and states that it formulates and manufactures aloe-based Skin, Hair & Sun Care products at its cosmetic production plant in Aruba.
The official contact page lists the Aruba Aloe Factory, Museum & Store at Pitastraat 115, Oranjestad, Aruba and invites visitors to experience production from plant to product.
Senior & Co.'s official history states that the present firm Senior & Co. was incorporated and produces Senior's Curaçao Liqueur.
The official contact page lists the Curaçao Liqueur Distillery at Landhuis Chobolobo in Willemstad, Curaçao.
